statement: Generate intersection geometry from approach streets with curb returns and conflict areas.

intersections built from approach legs (bearing, width, length) in any order: a 4-leg cross (2090.9140 m2), a T (1015.4570), a 60-degree crossing (1926.0895), a bend (547.7285) against closed forms (strip union plus r^2 / tan(theta/2) - r^2 (pi - theta) / 2 per return plus chord segments); tangency of every return; conflict areas against the half-carriageway partition identity w1 w2 / sin(theta) and a 1 cm grid count
